# Quaternius Fantasy Props MegaKit - ordinary prop selection

11 unmodified original FBXs: one crate, barrel, bench, stool, rope coil, closed
book, bottle, pot, peg rack, workbench and wall shelf. No combat/fantasy items.
Original source: https://quaternius.com/packs/fantasypropsmegakit.html
Original download: https://quaternius.itch.io/fantasy-props-megakit
Author: Quaternius. CC0 1.0 Universal; exact License_Standard.txt retained.

The simple wood faces and everyday silhouettes fit the Paper Theatre harbour,
workshop and house references. Limit changes to the reference palette, paper
surface, small scale/pivot corrections and texture relinking. The source texture
sets used by these models are retained, including the creator's alternate Unreal
normal maps. Their source material slots are documented in SOURCE.json.

The street lantern, open ledger, bell, plant and hoist remain explicit gaps. The
cage-like wall lantern was omitted because it does not match the defining street
lantern silhouette closely enough. Creator previews and metadata were inspected;
All 11 FBXs passed a separate Blender 5.2.2 LTS background import with no
unresolved referenced texture images after original-image relinking. Eight
representative stock-material renders were inspected. Book and bottle source
colour attributes survive import, but their FBX material graphs do not connect
a vertex-colour shader node; inspect that connection when preparing a derived
working material. The stool seat is round. Source bytes and hashes remain
unchanged. UE 4.27.2 import/render verification remains pending.
